authority.OBDATA086: Canonical evidence origin, source-family, origin-family and independence-family identity.
authority.OBDATA089: Corroboration weight counts independent families, not raw observation quantity.

doctrine: admitted evidence is not automatically independent evidence
multiple observations are not automatically multiple confirmations
same source family cannot inflate corroboration
same upstream origin family cannot inflate corroboration
explicit shared dependency cannot inflate corroboration
unknown dependency receives no independent-confirmation credit
known_boundary: OBDATA086-090 does not rewrite OBDATA081-085 candidate admission.
Independence metadata is an explicit authority layer; future adapters must bind it to canonical provenance receipts rather than allowing arbitrary callers to manufacture source-family claims.
A VALID corroboration-weight assessment means the count is structurally coherent as evaluated; it does not establish analytical sufficiency or a trading conclusion.
Currentness, lifecycle, revocation and upstream reasoning eligibility remain governed by prior authorities.
title: Evidence Independence + Corroboration-Weight Integrity
